results.summary:
The page details Anthropic’s pricing for Claude API and cloud platform usage, all in USD. Key points:

- Model pricing: base input tokens, output tokens, and prompt caching costs per model (examples: Claude Opus 4.x, Sonnet 4.x, Haiku 4.x). Cache-related charges include 5-minute writes, 1-hour writes, and cache hits/refreshes, with specified multipliers. Example pricing shown per model, with Opus 4.x generally at $5 per MTok input, $25 per MTok output, and cache multipliers (e.g., 1.25x for 5-minute writes, 2x for 1-hour writes, 0.1x for cache reads).
- Cache pricing mechanics: prompt caching reduces repeated processing by storing and reusing content. Cache write tokens are charged upfront; cache read tokens are charged on retrieval; a cache hit costs 10% of the base input price (aligned with multipliers).
- Cloud platform pricing: pricing for partner-operated clouds; includes Claude Platform on AWS and Vertex AI; regional/multi-region endpoints incur a 10% premium over global endpoints; data residency pricing options exist.
- Claude Platform on AWS: billed via AWS Marketplace using Claude Consumption Units (CCUs), converted from token usage and reported hourly; AWS bill shows a single CCU line item.
- Regional pricing notes: first-party Claude API is global by default; data residency options may affect pricing.
- For the most current pricing, refer to claude.com/pricing.
